{{Quote|I hope you get them all. No wonder the Seps managed to land here. The Jedi were traitors all along. You're doing a wonderful job, trooper.|Unidentified [[Biravian]]|<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
This '''Biravian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] officer who worked for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the war, she believed in [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] lies about the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] betraying the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].
